rationale: The discourse has hardened into a stable impasse: management, owners, investors, and Lower Saxony accept a no-closure route only if it is closure-equivalent, while IG Metall and the works council continue to reject closures and compulsory redundancies as live fallback tools. The expert clarified technical feasibility, but the core distributive conflict over burden, guarantees, and fallback remains unresolved and unlikely to move without a structured intervention.
